orientationDetermination.question: hm08's Blender-scene face orientation, so the Z-height branch of apply_mesh_native_scalp_hair_material_region (expects face at -Y) gets the right face-exclusion.

evidence.method: MPFB landmark vertex groups (basemesh_vertex_groups.json helper-l-eye / helper-r-eye) centroid computed in raw base.obj coordinates
evidence.result: eyes at OBJ z=+1.245; OBJ is Y-up (long axis Y:[-8.45,8.50]) -> face at OBJ +Z

evidence.method: headless Blender probe: wm.obj_import of base.obj (the stage's exact load path, force_z=False) then nose-vs-back X-extent signature in the head region
evidence.result: Blender Z-up standing; face at Blender -Y (nose = narrow 0.07 X-extent at -Y extreme vs 1.60 at +Y extreme). wm.obj_import maps OBJ Y->Blender Z and OBJ Z->Blender -Y, so OBJ face-at-+Z becomes Blender face-at--Y

evidence.method: NodeIO probe of the EXPORTED hm08 library GLBs (Y-up, export_yup=True) using the same nose-vs-back signature, validated against the two known-good GLBs
evidence.result: Anny known-good face at +Z (0.020 vs 0.177 band X-extents), MPFB subject face at +Z (0.071 vs 0.160), hm08 lean face at +Z (0.015 vs 0.051), hm08 heavy face at +Z (0.018 vs 0.137). glTF Y-up maps Blender -Y -> GLB +Z, so Blender face at -Y confirmed end-to-end

orientationDetermination.conclusion: hm08 Blender-scene face is at -Y, which is exactly what the function's Z-height branch expects. NO 180-deg Z flip is needed (unlike the MPFB create_human rail, which faces +Y). Wiring: import the proven function from tools/openclinxr/asset-pipeline/anny/automate_blender.py and call it directly on the Z-up basemesh after the coverage gate, before armature bind.
orientationDetermination.blenderToGlbMapping: Blender +Y -> GLB -Z; Blender +Z -> GLB +Y; Blender +X -> GLB +X (export_yup=True)
